# Magisk installer source

`update-binary` and `updater-script` derive from [BCP v1.1](https://github.com/chenxiaolong/BCP/tree/0350949cc1a8b83bebc725cf25256b259c61edf9), commit `0350949cc1a8b83bebc725cf25256b259c61edf9`.
